messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: svc-inference-eu: elevated 5xx rate detected -> 10% error rate, autoscale thrash observed. page: @sam_oncall (sev 2)

sam_oncall: on it. joining Zoom. pulling logs now. any customer reports?

maria_ops: seeing spike ~02:38 UTC, errors mainly during KV cache warmups, some requests timing out after queueing. routing retries piling on.

ops-sre: @sam_oncall fyi: rolling deploy to a/b clusters finished ~02:20, maybe related. trying 1 node restart on cluster-eu-a to drain bad conns.

sam_oncall: ack. restarting node now. will monitor for 5m. if remains, rollback canary.

incident-bot: Zoom started by sam_oncall -> https://zoom.company/xxxxx (auto-record)

maria_ops: node restart completed. error rate down to ~6% but still above target. tracing shows increased queue depth at frontend router for requests with long prompt lengths (>8k tokens).

sam_oncall: adding temporary rate-limiter for long requests to protect p99 latency. TTL 10m.

nina_prod: quick note — product PMs asking for exact impacted window for status page + customer comms. they need wording that won't overpromise on root cause yet.

sam_oncall: agreed. we have partial mitigation but degraded for some workloads. propose status: "Degraded performance for text generation in EU region between 02:20–03:10 UTC; some requests may have timed out or seen higher error rates. We’re continuing to investigate and mitigate."

jack_cs: draft customer message please — we need something concise for affected customers. include a link to status and an offer to review billing credits if eligible.

maria_ops: drafting status update now. suggestion: ```Status: Degraded service — We are experiencing elevated error rates and latency for text generation in EU region. Impact: Some requests returned errors or timed out between 02:20 and 03:10 UTC UTC. Mitigation: We have restarted affected nodes, applied short-term rate limiting for large requests, and are rolling clean canary. Next: Further investigation into upstream deploy interactions and queueing logic.```

nina_prod: ok that reads well. please avoid phrase "outage". add: "No data loss" if confirmed.

sam_oncall: confirmed no loss of log or model artifacts. add line: "No data loss detected."

incident-bot: Status page update proposed by maria_ops: https://status.redwood.ai/updates/xxxx (preview)

jack_cs: customer draft (short): ```Hi — we wanted to let you know about degraded performance affecting the EU inference endpoint earlier today between 02:20–03:10 UTC. Some requests may have timed out or returned errors. We’re continuing to investigate; our SRE team applied mitigations and the service is returning to normal. If you experienced user impact, please reply and we’ll review eligibility for service credit.```

emily_billing: ping — we'll need impacted account list + per-customer window to assess credits. can ops provide request logs scoped by account?

maria_ops: yes. exporting logs now. hitting ~1300 unique customers in EU region with >=1 failed request; majority are <5 failed reqs. I'll attach CSV to ticket when ready. ETA 20m.

emily_billing: thanks. for credit calc: our policy prorates by minutes of degraded SLA per account tier. we'll compute candidate credits and flag any enterprise customers for manual review. please include peak error rate per account if possible.

ops-sre: note: there were two separate spikes — primary spike 02:20–02:48 and a smaller flare 03:00–03:10 after a canary retry. recommend we treat continuous impacted window as 02:20–03:10 for comms, but billing team should consider two discrete windows when calculating exact credits.

sam_oncall: agree. communicationally keep single window to avoid confusion. billing can use logs for fine-grained calc.

jack_cs: CS script to send to customers who reply: ```Thanks — we’re investigating and will follow up within 48 hours with remediation details and any credit eligibility. If you can share affected request IDs or example prompts that helps triage.```

emily_billing: quick Q: do we auto-issue credits for customers below threshold or require opt-in? current policy: auto for customers with >5% of requests affected during window or enterprise SLA triggers. need confirmation from finance if any manual overrides.

maria_ops: I'll include percent impacted per account in the export. EMILY — I can tag accounts that hit >5% in the CSV.

emily_billing: perfect. also include account billing tier column. finance will need that to calculate waiver amounts.

nina_prod: we should prepare an internal postmortem template entry now to capture timeline and decisions: short timeline, root-cause hypothesis (deploy canary + KV cache warm), mitigations, customer impact, next actions.

sam_oncall: adding TODOs: (1) revert canary logic that triggers aggressive retries for long requests, (2) add circuit-breaker on queue depth threshold, (3) add telemetry for prompt length vs queueing.

incident-bot: action added to incident board: https://incidents/board/INC-2026-457?action=assign

ops-sre: FYI — I found one midnight deploy with config change to `router.max_concurrent_streams` that lowered default; rolling it back prevented the second flare.

maria_ops: exporting CSV: attached -> /incidents/2275001234/exports/impact-2275001234.csv (contains account_id, impacted_requests, total_requests, percent_impacted, peak_error_rate)

emily_billing: got it. starting credit calc run now. will produce candidate list and amounts in ~30m.

jack_cs: once billing confirms, CS will prep personalized emails for top 50 impacted accounts. for smaller customers we'll send batch notice with how to request review.

nina_prod: flagged for legal review: wording around "service credit" must match TOS verbiage. legal, please standby.

sam_oncall: final status check — error rate back to baseline ~0.5% and p99 latency normal. keeping monitoring on for 2 hours.

jack_cs: thanks team. I'll queue the status page publish once legal okays wording.

emily_billing: credit calc complete: preliminary results attached -> /incidents/2275001234/exports/credits-proposals.csv. preliminary auto-eligible: 87 accounts, enterprise manual review: 6 accounts.

maria_ops: note on one enterprise account — heavy load from long-prompt batch jobs which we saw retrying and contributing to queue pressure. ops will reach out to suggest mitigation patterns.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to "Mitigated" by sam_oncall at 03:12 UTC.

sam_oncall: creating postmortem draft now, will include timeline and the 3 TODOs. assigning owners. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

jack_cs: putting CS follow-up reminders for one week to ensure customers received credits/answers.

emily_billing: billing will schedule offsets next billing cycle for auto-issued credits and will coordinate enterprise adjustments with account reps. I'll post final numbers in the ticket when complete.

nina_prod: good job. keep incident open until all customer comms and billing ops completed.

ops-sre: adding long-term action: improve canary rollback automation to detect queueing regressions within 5m.

sam_oncall: closing Zoom. will keep monitoring. thanks all.
